name: mf_fno_transfer_pinn
description: Physics-informed transfer-learning FNO (FiLM conditioning). Identical to mf_fno_transfer_film (pretrain on LF, fine-tune on HF, FiLM-on-X) except the HF fine-tuning adds a scale-free PDE-operator-matching loss lambda*||L[u_pred]-L[u_hf]||^2 on datasets with a cleanly recoverable elliptic operator: Laplacian for poisson_generated/poisson_local/ifc_poisson, weighted Laplacian div(a grad u) for darcy_generated (a=exp(upsampled 4x4 X). Source-free (at HF points L[u]=-f), so no generator/analytic source needed. lambda=0 on all other datasets (== FiLM-transfer), isolating the physics term. Tests whether physics-operator supervision beats pure data-driven transfer in the scarce-HF regime.
paper: Raissi et al. 2019 PINNs (J. Comput. Phys.) + Lyu et al. 2023 transfer MF-FNO (arXiv:2304.06972). Physics-operator-matching fine-tuning on top of the transfer baseline.
